title: DiTGaze: Geometry-Conditioned Diffusion Augmentation for Few-Shot Gaze Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2511.11231v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Accurate person-specific gaze estimation benefits from labeled user data, but collecting images that densely cover gaze directions is burdensome. We present DiTGaze, a calibration-efficient augmentation system that follows a two-stream 3D Gaussian Splatting backbone and reformulates its convolutional rendering stage as a geometry-conditioned latent Diffusion Transformer (DiT). A learnable projection and frozen VAE bridge rasterized Gaussian features to latent tokens, while timestep and identity/expression conditioning are integrated through Adaptive Layer Normalization. Intermediate yaw-pitch sampling densifies gaze supervision, and an orthogonality constraint reduces interference between gaze, pose, and expression. On ETH-XGaze, DiTGaze reduces generator-level gaze error by 4.1 percent relative to GazeGaussian. translated_title: DiTGaze：面向少样本视线估计的几何条件扩散增强方法
translated_abstract: 精确的个性化视线估计受益于带标注的用户数据，但采集密集覆盖各视线方向的图像十分繁琐。我们提出DiTGaze，一种校准高效的增强系统，它采用双流3D高斯泼溅（3D Gaussian Splatting）骨干网络，并将其卷积渲染阶段重新构建为几何条件化的潜在扩散Transformer（DiT）。通过可学习的投影和冻结的VAE，将光栅化的高斯特征桥接到潜在标记，同时通过自适应层归一化（Adaptive Layer Normalization）整合时间步与身份/表情条件。中间偏航-俯仰角采样密化了视线监督信号，正交性约束则减少了视线、姿态与表情之间的干扰。在ETH-XGaze数据集上，DiTGaze相比GazeGaussian将生成器层面的视线误差降低了4.1%。在我们运行的扩展下游协议中，它在1到9张真实图像的所有校准预算下均排名第一。
tldr: DiTGaze提出一种几何条件化的潜在扩散Transformer增强系统，通过中间视线方向采样与正交性约束实现高效校准，在ETH-XGaze上相比GazeGaussian降低4.1%的视线误差，并在所有校准预算下均取得最优的少样本个性化视线估计性能。
